new_defect_types.name: functional_semantics_inconsistency (traffic/diagram logic)
new_defect_types.description: Signs, road markings, arrows or diagram annotations are each well formed, but their combined meaning is contradictory or nonsensical: opposing flow arrows, double-headed lane arrows, meshing gears drawn rotating the same way, a yield line drawn as a zebra.
examples: phi399/flux3_klein: near-side circulatory arrows point left while the chevrons point right
phi399/flux3_klein_base: up/down double arrow in the ego lane
orig155/gemini_3_1_flash_image: both meshing gears annotated clockwise
phi399/fibo2_dev: left arrow and right-curving arrow in one entry lane
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A10 asks whether a diagram makes sense, but VLMs read it as object structure; A19 covers out-of-place objects, not wrong semantics among in-place ones.

new_defect_types.name: container_continuity_violation
new_defect_types.description: The contents of a transparent container are larger than the container where they sit, the glass wall vanishes or ends at the content, or content appears outside the walls.
examples: orig399/gpt_image_2: Earth 2x the width of the hourglass neck, glass walls vanish into it
orig399/flux3_klein: sand rings orbit outside the glass
orig399/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst: glass ends at the globe
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A08 covers interpenetration of opaque objects; transparent glass makes the violation subtle, and none of the examples cover containers.

new_defect_types.name: material_state_error
new_defect_types.description: A material is shown in the wrong physical state, such as solid agar as liquid broth with floating beads, or colonies visible inside the gel depth.
examples: phi34/krea2_turbo: deep liquid agar with floating bead colonies, colonies seen through the side wall
phi34/gpt_image_2: colonies look like droplets on liquid
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A12 lists liquids and cloth behaviour but not the case where a solid is rendered as a liquid.

new_defect_types.name: competing_unrequested_text
new_defect_types.description: Correctly spelled, legible but unrequested slogans or labels added near or behind the requested text, diluting it or paraphrasing the prompt.
examples: orig514/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high: 5 sharp background slogans around the requested T-shirt quote
orig155/gemini_3_1_flash_image: "SLOW ROTATION", "DRIVE SOURCE" labels
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B04 covers prompt words as unrequested text only partly; B07 is about objects. A03 does not apply because the text is not pseudo-text.

new_defect_types.name: requested_format_missing
new_defect_types.description: The prompt names an output format or genre (an app onboarding page, a poster, a UI), and the model renders only the subject illustration with no format elements.
examples: orig38: 7 of 12 models (fibo2_dev, flux3_klein, gpt_image_2, gpt_image_2p5_sunburst_quality_high, ideogram4_nf4, krea2_turbo, qwen_image_2p1_nope) have no UI chrome
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B05 covers style and medium; it is ambiguous whether a missing page or UI wrapper is B02 or B05.

rubric_issues.problem: No explicit guidance for mechanisms (gears) or functional markings, so overlapping coplanar gears and contradictory arrows are easy to pass.
examples: orig155/krea2_turbo red gear superimposed on blue
orig155: 7/12 gears overlap rather than mesh
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add: "For mechanisms, gears must interleave without overlapping, meshing gears counter-rotate, and belts and chains must close. Arrows and markings must not contradict each other."

rubric_issues.problem: Prompts with negated physics ("sand does NOT flow down") or partial reveals ("only ears and eyes visible") fail most often; v2 has no note that the stereotypical default (sand falls, whole fox shown) is the failure mode to check.
examples: orig399: 6/12 show normal sand flow
orig276: 6/12 show the full fox face or body
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add to Layer B: "When the prompt negates a default behaviour or limits visibility, verify that the default did not occur; the default is major when it is the prompt's point."

rubric_issues.problem: A font or style switch inside one word (italic "on" in "rebellion") is not listed.
examples: orig514/ideogram4_nf4
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add "inconsistent typeface/weight/slant within one string" to the A02 checklist.

rubric_issues.problem: Quote marks from the prompt printed into the image, and prompt jargon ("ego") leaking into overlays, are unaddressed.
examples: orig514/gemini_3_1_flash_image prints ‘…’
phi399/gemini_3_1_flash_image "ego 23 mph"
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Printed prompt delimiters = minor B04; prompt meta-words (ego, photorealistic, 35mm) written into the image = B04 moderate.

rubric_issues.problem: It does not separate requested brands from injected ones.
examples: phi150/gpt_image_2p5_sunburst "United Rentals" truck when only Boston Dynamics was requested
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Report requested vs unrequested brands separately.

rubric_issues.problem: Requested camera height or angle ("upward from street level", "low dashcam") has no clear home: B08 is shot size and B06 is layout.
examples: phi511/fibo2_dev looks down on the roof
phi399/gemini_3_1_flash_image camera at mirror height
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Extend B08 to "shot size, framing and camera viewpoint/height/angle".
